scientific_integrity: The proof applies to the uniformly weighted simple graph obtained by identifying two vertices across M copies of the integer line; all point-spectrum assertions are derived analytically and reproducible checks are auxiliary.
scientific_limitations: No conclusions about inequivalent lengths, weighted or magnetic edges, metric quantum graphs, scattering lineshapes or physical implementations. An equivalent general spectral-theory derivation cannot be excluded by finite literature searches; a relevant crossbar paper was not available in full text.
title: Exact point spectrum of a two-junction array of identical tight-binding wires
